intro.title: marmaestro
intro.subtitle: Game Developer, Designer and Producer.
body: I'm a 24-year-old game developer and designer. I'm currently finishing my degree at Jaume I University.
I have hands-on experience in game programming, producing and design. My work centers on analytical problem-solving and solid technical foundations.
I love crafting engaging player experiences. I'm always experimenting with new tools and techniques to bring interactive worlds to life.
I'm also passionate about film photography and birds.

skills.title: My Skills
skills.body: I've built a solid understanding of game development and other branches of computer engineering through my studies and personal projects. I've put those skills to work on several projects.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.body: I love creating things: games, podcasts, and more. Here's some of my work.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.description: My film photography works. I shoot as a hobby on a Nikon FM-2 and an Olympus PEN EE-3.

contact.title: Let's create something together
contact.body: Feel free to reach out if you're looking for a game developer, designer or producer, have a question, or just want to connect.
contact.message: I'll be glad to message back.
